column1: # Tamagi — catalog of everything optional (`tamagi install`, first login).
# The image is lean: nothing here ships in it. One item per line, TAB separated:
#   flatpak:<remote>:<app id>   Flatpak app, in the user (no password)
#   gaming:<key>                native gaming layer, like Bazzite (tamagi gaming native <key>...)
#   run:<command>               any other command, run in the terminal
# Category and description are written in English (the key of the
# translations in /usr/share/tamagi/i18n) and shown in the system language.
# The Flatpak apps of flatpaks.list (type "opcional") join this catalog.
